executivePulse.interpretation: The situation for memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM / RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the most constrained areas. The Daily Check of 2026-08-31 reviewed 8 relevant reports; it finds no confirmed material directional change. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure, but will reach the market only with a lag. For buyers, securing supply, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
